# BrainFacts

> > BrainFacts is a comprehensive neuroscience education resource covering brain function, health, development, diseases, and sensory systems for learners of all levels.

BrainFacts.org provides evidence-based information on how the brain works, from cognitive development and learning to neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's and Dementia. The site combines neuroscience education with practical brain health guidance across the lifespan.

## Key Topics

- Neuroscience
- Brain Function
- Brain Health
- Brain Development
- Learning & Memory
- Cognitive Science
- Sensory Systems
- Mental Health
- Alzheimer's & Dementia
- Sleep
- Emotions & Stress
- Addiction
- Consciousness
- Motor Control
- Neurological Disorders

## Core Resources

- [BrainFacts Homepage](https://www.brainfacts.org): BrainFacts homepage covering neuroscience education and brain health topics
- [Thinking, Sensing & Behaving](https://www.brainfacts.org/thinking-sensing-and-behaving): Resource directory covering neuroscience topics and brain functions

## Cognitive Function & Development

- [Learning & Memory](https://www.brainfacts.org/thinking-sensing-and-behaving/learning-and-memory): Topic overview of learning, memory, Alzheimer's & Dementia
- [Thinking & Awareness](https://www.brainfacts.org/thinking-sensing-and-behaving/thinking-and-awareness): Topic overview of thinking, awareness, and consciousness neuroscience
- [Brain Development](https://www.brainfacts.org/thinking-sensing-and-behaving/brain-development): Educational resource on brain development and cognitive growth
- [Childhood & Adolescence](https://www.brainfacts.org/thinking-sensing-and-behaving/childhood-and-adolescence): Guide to brain development during childhood and adolescence
- [Language](https://www.brainfacts.org/thinking-sensing-and-behaving/language): Guide to language processing and brain function in language

## Sensory Systems

- [Vision](https://www.brainfacts.org/thinking-sensing-and-behaving/vision): Guide to visual perception and vision neuroscience
- [Hearing](https://www.brainfacts.org/thinking-sensing-and-behaving/hearing): Educational resource on auditory perception and hearing neuroscience
- [Touch](https://www.brainfacts.org/thinking-sensing-and-behaving/touch): Guide to touch sensation and tactile sensory perception
- [Smell](https://www.brainfacts.org/thinking-sensing-and-behaving/smell): Guide to olfaction and smell perception related to COVID-19
- [Taste](https://www.brainfacts.org/thinking-sensing-and-behaving/taste): Educational resource on taste perception and sensory systems

## Brain Health & Lifestyle

- [Sleep](https://www.brainfacts.org/thinking-sensing-and-behaving/sleep): Guide to sleep science, sleep disorders, and brain health
- [Emotions, Stress & Anxiety](https://www.brainfacts.org/thinking-sensing-and-behaving/emotions-stress-and-anxiety): Guide to emotions, stress, anxiety, and mental health neuroscience
- [Diet & Lifestyle](https://www.brainfacts.org/thinking-sensing-and-behaving/diet-and-lifestyle): Information on diet, lifestyle, and their effects on brain health
- [Aging](https://www.brainfacts.org/thinking-sensing-and-behaving/aging): Guide to brain aging, cognitive changes, and Alzheimer's & Dementia

## Diseases & Disorders

- [Alzheimer's & Dementia](https://www.brainfacts.org/diseases-and-disorders/topic-center-alzheimers-and-dementia): Topic center for Alzheimer's & Dementia with disease information
- [Addiction](https://www.brainfacts.org/diseases-and-disorders/addiction): Guide to addiction neuroscience and substance abuse disorders

## Motor & Physical Function

- [Movement](https://www.brainfacts.org/thinking-sensing-and-behaving/movement): Guide to motor control and movement neuroscience
- [Pain](https://www.brainfacts.org/thinking-sensing-and-behaving/pain): Educational resource on pain sensation and perception
